title: Air Fryer Chicken Sandwich
description: A healthier take on the crispy chicken sandwich using an air fryer.

steps.1: Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, then coat heavily in Panko breadcrumbs.
steps.3: Spray chicken with oil and air fry, flipping halfway through. ?timer-12:00?
steps.4: Toast buns and assemble with chicken and pickles.
